title: 2025 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: Lucius is counting backward by \(7\)s. His first three numbers are \(100,\) \(93,\) and \(86.\) What is his \(10\)th number?

solutions.text:
There will be \(10 - 1 = 9\) gaps between his first number \(100\) and his \(10\)th number. Each gap has size \(7.\)

So, he will subtract a total of \(9 \times 7 = 63\) from \(100,\) leaving an answer of \(100 - 63 = 37,\) which is choice B.
hints: The \(10\)th number is \(9\) steps after the \(1\)st
Subtract nine 7s from the first term
